therapeutics_text: > MARUM VERUM TEUCRIUM. I have found this remedy one of the best for ascarides. Have cured many cases who had " tried everything " (so they said) without avail. I have noticed that people troubled with ascarides often have a great deal of tickling, tingling, etc., in the nose, which they are frequently rubbing. (Children troubled with ascarides have this symptom.) And it is notable that Teucrium is one of the best remedies for polypus of the nose; will cure it, and that never to return. I have a preparation of the remedy, made on the Santee potentizer, 50m., which does the best of any preparation I ever used.
